name: Fraport AG
summary: Fraport AG owns and operates airports in Germany, the rest of Europe, Asia, and the America. It primarily focuses on the operation of Frankfurt Main airport. The company operates through four segments: Aviation, Retail & Real Estate, Ground Handling, and International Activities & Services. The Aviation segment operates land and airside infrastructure, which covers the area of airport charges and related security services. The Retail & Real Estate segment engages in retail activities; and real estate activities, including development and rental of commercial real estate properties and land.
